## About

This artifact is an example docker container. This artifact is maintained by the MCR Team.
Check in for updates.

## Featured Tags

    docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/mcr/hello-world:v1.0
    
|Tags  | Architecture | OS |
|------|--------------|----|
| v1.0 | AMD64 | Linux|
| v2.0 | ARM64 | Linux

## Related Repositories

Related Repositories from ingestionTest YAML Files

**Public Repositories:**

- `public/mcr/ci/hello-world-cus` - MCR Ingestion CUS Test Image
- `public/mcr/ci/hello-world-wus2` - MCR Ingestion WUS2 Test Image
- `public/mcr/ci/hello-world-eus` - MCR Ingestion EUS Test Image (Canary)

**Internal/Microsoft-Only Repositories:**

- `msftonly/mcr/ci/imar-hello-world-cus` - MCR Ingestion CUS Test Image (Internal)
- `msftonly/mcr/ci/imar-hello-world-wus2` - MCR Ingestion WUS2 Test Image (Internal)
- `msftonly/mcr/ci/imar-hello-world-eus` - MCR Ingestion EUS Test Image (Internal)

## Usage

All repositories are test images used for:

- Testing image ingestion and ORAS artifact syndication
- Validating MCR functionality across different Azure regions (Central US, West US 2, and East US/Canary)
- Both public and internal testing scenarios
